Material Type: PCV
Swimming pool size:210x135x55cm,180x130x55cm,150x110x50cm, 145x100x45cm,125x75x45cm,120x85x35cm
Suitable age: 5 years old and above
Applicable: indoor, outdoor, garden, suburb, balcony
Swimming pools are easily inflated. Easy to deflate and store after use. The family pool is perfect for the whole family to have fun together. Home pool walls are made of durable vinyl.
Tips
1. It should be noted that children must be supervised by adults when playing in the swimming pool.
2. Before building a large swimming pool, be sure to check whether there are sharp objects, and then put them on the ground. 
3. Don't fill a large swimming pool more than 2/3 full.
4. It is recommended to use an electric air pump to inflate the pool.
